oracle: casatasks and casatools 6.7.6.14, Linux x86_64 wheels
inputs: Committed public sm_total_power/pb_alma.image and vla.d/alma.out01/aca.tp configurations; both implementations use the bundled measures snapshot. Input bytes are checked before/after each final operation.
preservation: Continuation checks exact original DATA, flags, weights, SIGMA, TIME, UVW and spectral columns within each implementation. Rejected existing-project operations compare all file bytes in memory, excluding transient locks. Inputs and an unrelated project product are preserved. Successful overwrite changes model DATA; manual continuation replaces an existing noisy output.
corrections: Existing CASA path correction: nested relative/absolute native project paths are compared to CASA plain-name controls with the same basename. Raw CASA limitation is documented in docs/CASA (C++) bugs.md.
Existing input-alias correction: CASA deletes the model image it is about to read and raises; native refuses before changing project bytes. Both raw outcomes are recorded.

Leakage in obsmode="" is intentionally ignored by CASA (the task gates it on predict=True); no fullpol product is invented. Output-frame requests in continuation preserve the original MS spectral frame.
preserved_evidence: Existing project-link overwrite and relative-project numerical quick-PSF regressions remain valid. No production code, prediction/corruption operator, backend, allocation ownership or scientific tolerance changes; existing accepted performance/memory evidence applies.
limits: Representative stateful project workflows, not an exhaustive Cartesian sweep, generic filesystem transaction redesign, new throughput claim or plotting.
